note: Seeded by the scaffold corpus (class: adapted) with the sha256 of each corpus-shipped council verifier at the corpus version that delivered it. An unadapted copy refreshes with every cascade, so its pins track the corpus without hand work. The corpus manifest checksum is the fleet-wide pin of the same bytes; this file is the run-time working-tree gate (scripts/verify-pins.ts, run at council Setup).
